tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List every market (kind of AI API) that has prices, with its id and pricing unit. Start here to find the market id.

tools.name: describe_market
tools.description: Explain one market: what it is, how its pricing works, and the attributes you can filter and compare on (with plain-language help).

tools.name: search_offerings
tools.description: Rank the offerings in one market by price, quality and speed, with optional requirements and a maximum price. Returns prices with their verification date and source.

tools.name: get_offering
tools.description: Full detail for one offering: description, capabilities, current price with its source, price history, and where_to_buy (the same model at other hosts, cheapest first) when there is one.

tools.name: compare_offerings
tools.description: Put 2 to 4 offerings from the same market side by side: prices, scores and every capability.

tools.name: plan_stack
tools.description: Plan the whole AI stack of an app in one place: it is split into parts (for example speech-to-text, a language model, text-to-speech), each part gets the best-ranked offering, alternatives and an estimated monthly cost. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "plan_stack" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Plan the whole AI stack of an app in one place: it is split into parts (for example speech-to-text, a language model, text-to-speech), each part gets the best-r…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "plan_stack" is 994 chars, far longer than this server's median (148). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Plan the whole AI stack of an app in one place: it is split into parts (for example speech-to-text, a language model, text-to-speech), each part gets the best-r…

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_offering" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Full detail for one offering: description, capabilities, current price with its source, and price history." → after: "Full detail for one offering: description, capabilities, current price with its source, price history, and where_to_buy (the same model at other hosts, cheapest first) when there is one."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
